title: Overdraft Fee Policy
text: Overdraft transactions incur a flat fee of 25 USD per occurrence, capped at 3 fees per day.

title: International Transfer Policy
text: International wire transfers are processed within 1-3 business days and incur a 15 USD flat fee.

title: Card Replacement Policy
text: Lost or stolen cards are replaced free of charge within 5-7 business days; expedited shipping costs 20 USD.

title: Interest Rate Policy
text: Savings accounts earn 2.1% APY, compounded monthly, subject to change with 30 days notice.
